committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 29 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Weekly ad spend is A$135.68 (up from A$124.53) for 18 clicks at a cost per click of A$7.54, with zero conversions logged in Google Ads over the same seven days; across the landing-page test, A$453.81 ex-GST has been spent against A$92 of credit remaining for 69 raw paid clicks, and no qualified enquiry has been confirmed yet.

Click-through rate fell from 4.1% to 2.7% week on week even though impressions rose from 465 to 657; impression share sits at 10% with 76.1% of impressions lost to rank over the last 30 days, a gap that stays open under the fixed-budget test rule.

Of the 69 raw paid clicks captured since the landing page went live, 17 have triggered ask_cta_click (the question form) while review_cta_click and generate_lead both sit at zero; the page is well past the 25-click mark so headline, offer and CTAs remain frozen.

AI Assistant sessions dropped to zero in the last 7 days from 3 prior, with the chatgpt.com/ai-assistant pair falling from 3 to 0 sessions; Organic Search held flat at 9 sessions both periods and remains the only trustworthy unpaid signal, while Search Console data only runs through 26 Oct, two days before yesterday's figure (Wed 28).

actions.text: Raw paid clicks on the landing page now stand at 69, well past the 25-click checkpoint, so headline, offer and calls to action stay frozen unless something breaks.
Logo and image assets are still outstanding for the serving ad groups (Agency and Job Intake); get these sourced.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update these to match current site stats.
